from manim import *

class NeuronRefractoryGate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Refractory periods prevent immediate refiring", font_size=29).to_edge(UP)
        axon = Line(LEFT * 4, RIGHT * 4, color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=8)
        signal = Dot(LEFT * 3.4, color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.11)
        gate_line = Line(UP * 0.45, DOWN * 0.45, color=RED_D, stroke_width=6).shift(LEFT * 0.4)
        gate_label = Text("closed", font_size=21, color=RED_D).next_to(gate_line, DOWN)
        gate = VGroup(gate_line, gate_label)
        blocked = Dot(LEFT * 2.8, color=GRAY_B, radius=0.09)
        stop = Cross(blocked, stroke_color=RED_D)
        caption = Text("After one spike, the membrane needs time to reset.", font_size=24).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(axon), FadeIn(signal), run_time=2.5)
        self.play(signal.animate.move_to(RIGHT * 2.8), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(gate), FadeIn(blocked), Create(stop), run_time=2.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption), Indicate(gate, color=RED_A), run_time=2)
        self.wait(1)
